title: Recurring rules: biweekly cadence and pause/resume
pr_description: Adds the two most requested recurring-rule features: a biweekly cadence (every second week on a weekday) and pause/resume so users can suspend a subscription rule while keeping its history. Tests included for both.

defects.description: The biweekly branch matches every date whose weekday equals the rule's weekday — identical to weekly. Nothing tracks which alternate week the rule is anchored to, so a $200 'biweekly' rule charges $200 weekly, double-billing the user. Run occurrences_between over a 4-week window: it returns 4 dates, not 2.

resume_rule reactivates the rule but leaves last_materialized at its pre-pause value, and the docstring promises charging resumes 'from now'. The next materialize_due back-fills an expense for every occurrence during the paused period — a rule paused for six months gets six months of charges on resume. resume must also advance last_materialized to today.

The biweekly test spans only 8 days, a window in which weekly and biweekly cadences produce the identical single occurrence — it cannot distinguish the two. A 4-week window would fail against this implementation.
